verdict.rationale: Docs confirm a real ledger model: every fund movement creates a Transaction object (the ledger entry) and there's an event (v2.money_management.transaction.created) that fires when a transaction is created, plus guidance on using transactions for reconciliation and activity feeds. However, the evidence doesn't show a full webhook taxonomy covering every transaction state change (e.g., hold placed/released, pending→posted) or explicit documentation that balance reads reflect holds/pending activity in real time. missing for 10: full webhook event catalog for all transaction state transitions, explicit real-time balance API behavior for pending/held funds, independent developer corroboration of real-time accuracy.
